Which is the ratio of the opposite side.explanation: Sine is the ratio of the length of the side opposite an angle to the length of the hypotenuse in a right triangle.

Which is the ratio of the adjacent side.explanation: Cosine is the ratio of the length of the side adjacent to an angle to the length of the hypotenuse in a right triangle.

Who is the father of Trigonemetry?.explanation: While there are several contributors to the field of trigonometry, Hipparchus is often considered the father of trigonometry.
